limitations: Invented example for candidate 046f (R47b-R58, route v4.2). No real material list, contract, customer, company or resource; the glossary is an invented placeholder.

Source: the company material list (材料清單), the bound job source (R47b, O17). The contract is not packed for the generator, and the packet has no brand table: I and J come only from the material list's cells (R55, O17), so R002, R006 and R009 leave them null.
Quoted range: rows 4-19 of 材料清單, ending at row 20 (合計 in the unit-price column E20). The 合計 in B16 is a block total in the description column (R49).
Totals observed, not repaired (R10): the block total F16 = 104800 equals the amounts of rows 4-13; the end total F20 = 108200 adds F18 and F19.
G1 is the one-row physical_enclosure carrier group of the R56 enclosure row R001.
R005, R007, R008, R010 and R011 have C null under R52 and stay research_draft (R57; route v4.2 warns R57_NULL_C_RESEARCH_DRAFT, and the export needs the portable writer mode v2).
Q is filled although source adoption is unverified (R54, O16; route v4.2 warns O16_Q_UNVERIFIED_ADOPTION). It is the quoted unit price, not evidence of an accepted contract rate.
